about: The channel's Instagram profile, written by Claude for the owner to paste (Instagram lets no app change a bio). Owner, HQ 2026-11-10: "Write a bio for the instagram". HQ ask instagram-bio holds it with Copy buttons.
name: Forged in Stoicism | Stoic Quotes
bio:
One Stoic lesson a day. Strength for the hard weeks.
Real quotes from Marcus Aurelius, Seneca & Epictetus.
👇 The Stoic Reset, a 30-day journal

why.name: The name is the only part of a profile Instagram search reads (the handle aside), so "Stoic Quotes" puts the account in front of people searching that. Instagram allows two name changes in 14 days.
why.bio: Line 1: what a visitor gets and for whom (doctrine 5: widen the door, the hard weeks). Line 2: why to trust it: every quote is verbatim from the source text (scripts/validate_quotes.py), rare in this niche. Line 3: the product, pointing at the link below the bio. No URL in the text: Instagram doesn't make bio text links tappable.
why.links: The first link shows under the bio, so the journal goes first; YouTube second for people who want more.
